title: Dishes of Africa
intro: Which country is each dish from? Origins follow Wikidata, and many foods are shared across borders, so these are single-country origins only.

questions.prompt: Which country is draw soup from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Nigeria as the country of origin of draw soup.

questions.prompt: Which country is Kube Cake from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Ghana as the country of origin of Kube Cake.
Wikidata gives Algeria as the country of origin of bourek.
Wikidata gives Ghana as the country of origin of Poloo.
Wikidata gives Mozambique as the country of origin of matapa.
Wikidata gives South Africa as the country of origin of boeber.
Wikidata gives Morocco as the country of origin of Ahriche.
Wikidata gives Cameroon as the country of origin of Ndolé.

questions.prompt: Which country is Ofe Oha from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Nigeria as the country of origin of Ofe Oha.
Wikidata gives Morocco as the country of origin of Taktouka.
